instruction: I frequently take screenshots while watching videos in VLC for reference. The default PNG format creates large files. Can you change the snapshot format to JPG to save disk space?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's snapshot format from PNG to JPG. The evaluator checks if the 'snapshot-format' setting in VLC configuration is set to 'jpg'. This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file (vlcrc) which stores the snapshot-format setting
Metric function properly parses the config file, looks for 'snapshot-format=' lines (excluding comments), and defaults to 'png' if not found
Comparison logic correctly checks if snapshot-format equals expected value 'jpg'
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (changing snapshot format to JPG)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are persisted and can be verified
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule() and accesses 'expected_snapshot_format' correctly
